decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The operations would consist the change of use of `122 London Road, Morden, SM4 5AT, as a House of Multiple Occupation (HMO) under C4 use class, in that the residential unit is used by three to six unrelated 
people. The development constitutes permitted development within the 
meaning of Class L of Part 3 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in Class L. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Condition : 2 - The operations, comprising an L-shaped rear dormer roof extension, would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Condition : 3 - The operations, comprising the installation of x3 rooflights to the front roof slope, would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Condition : 4 - Informative: The applicant is reminded that the certificate applies to the use of the property for a 6 persons HMO for 6b6p. Should the occupancy exceed 6 persons, planning permission should be sought

Condition : 5 - Informative: The applicant is reminded that properties of 5 or more persons require a HMO License from the Council as per the Housing Act 2004 Part 2. See more information at: Licensing of houses in multiple occupation | Merton Council
